test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 28 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2d03040db2d3c6fcd0e4949264822752a4b5083365cc0f11b12b4b976189de3.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) Alternately the element at the corner interchange positions diagonally starting from the 1st box.

2) Alternately all the elements shift anticlockwise starting from the 2nd box.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f9ea56a56d9c41f2bd844b70a3084047b2e777be3cfe6b7b3faa386ef2b00d6.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/993b98760172af40fe1bbed394e31835358a45d74c085ca673f30f52db0cd81b.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
